notes: TBox contraction paired with physics-replace-0007: removes the original rule of that revision ("every synchrotron accelerates particles around a closed loop"). Stored facts only; no indeterminate queries. Largely definitional (a synchrotron is a circular accelerator); slice results as definitional. The three derived queries name made-up synchrotrons (they ask the path shape, whether it is a straight line, and the layout of the beam hall) (inheritance, 2 hops); after the removal nothing else the model holds answers them, so the target is "does not know". Propositional targets follow strong Kleene logic and all become unknown. Near and far unrelated queries are kept from the revision (contraction is exempt from Rule 7). Residual risk: the word "synchrotron" may still evoke a ring.
